name: Surface Curvature Regularization
definition: A method to regularize implicit surface models (like SDFs) by computing and penalizing Gaussian and Mean curvatures, allowing direct surface regularization instead of regularizing projections.
summary: Surface Curvature Regularization penalizes Gaussian and Mean curvatures directly on neural implicit surfaces during training, distinguishing itself by operating on the final implicit function's differential geometry rather than projections.
